topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I just can’t let this slide, you know? It's hitting me hard that someone thinks you cheated. I mean, come on, I've been there when you spent nights holed up in the library, sifting through sources for your essay. You’ve got more dedication in your pinky than most people have in their whole bodies. Plagiarism? That’s downright ridiculous! We need to clear this up, and I’m with you every step of the way. Let’s show them the real you—the person who’s always put everything into their work, even when it’s been a struggle. It’s going to be okay, I promise. Let’s tackle this head-on, and get this mess sorted out once and for all.
